tileEnv.SH_FIXTURE_DESC: NeXTcube (Motorola 68040, 25 MHz, 64 MB, ROM Rev 2.5 v66) running NeXTSTEP 3.3 for m68k under the Previous emulator, resting on the Workspace the machine brings up for itself at login: grey workspace, the Workspace menu down the top left, the File Viewer showing the home directory, and the Dock along the right-hand edge with the recycler at the bottom. Nothing is curated: this is the desktop the machine brings up for itself, pixel-diffed back to that exact state after the one-time tablet-driver install the golden has to carry. 1120x832 MegaPixel display, pixel-exact on a 1120x832 X root. Pointer is ABSOLUTE: NeXTSTEP's own SummaGraphics tablet driver is attached inside the snapshot, so a commanded pixel is the pixel the NeXT arrow lands on; the guest draws that arrow itself.

museum.notes: Live streamhost tile. Emulator-in-captured-Linux BRIDGE tile: a captured Debian 12 kiosk runs the Previous emulator (SVN r1847 = 4.4, built into the tile's own overlay together with SDL3) as a real NeXTcube — Motorola 68040 at 25 MHz, 64 MB, ROM Rev 2.5 v66 — booting NeXTSTEP 3.3 for m68k off a SCSI disk image; streamhost captures the Linux framebuffer + AC97 audio like every other bridge tile. The X root is made EXACTLY the 1120x832 of the NeXT MegaPixel display so the picture is pixel-exact and both cursors clamp at the same edges. This is deliberately NOT the Intel build of NeXTSTEP, which cannot survive a modern QEMU's SCSI/IDE timing — see docs/guests/nextstep.md. Pointer is ABSOLUTE: Previous emulates a SummaGraphics digitiser on the NeXT's serial port B, and NeXTSTEP's own tablet driver is attached inside the golden, so the coordinate a QEMU usb-tablet delivers is the pixel the NeXT arrow lands on; the guest draws that arrow itself. archetype mono-terminal; the ideal asset is a bespoke matte-black cube. See streamhost/docs/BRIDGE.md.

reset.fixture: NeXTSTEP 3.3 Workspace on an emulated NeXTcube: grey workspace, the Workspace menu at the top left, the File Viewer the machine opens for itself at login, and the Dock down the right-hand edge. Baked 2026-08-09 from an untouched cold boot with nothing typed and nothing curated, and restore-verified by framebuffer in the same run (evidence/coldboot-desktop.png, golden-baked.png, golden-restored.png). Pointer and keyboard are recorded UNVERIFIED, not PASS: motion and keystrokes were both proven to reach the emulated machine by framebuffer, but the end-to-end browser path was not exercised and the NeXT KMS mouse register clamps a single delta to 63 px, so a fast flick under-moves. See docs/guests/nextstep.md.

notes: Bridge tile: Debian 12 kiosk + Previous 4.4 (SVN r1847) emulating a NeXTcube
Previous MUST be built with -DENABLE_RENDERING_THREAD=1 or guest input is silently dropped
media (NeXT ROM + NeXTSTEP disk image) is fetched at build time and never committed
